create_resnet50: create a ResNet50 model with specified number of classes and optional v2 architecture
build_resnet_model: build a configurable ResNet model with custom blocks per group and channels per group
create_bottleneck_block_v1: create a ResNet v1 bottleneck block with projection shortcut and batch normalization
create_bottleneck_block_v2: create a ResNet v2 pre-activation bottleneck block with zero-initialized final batch norm
build_block_group: build a block group containing multiple bottleneck blocks with configurable stride and channels
